subject: general
question: D, E. F. G, L, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F sits third to the left of L. N sits second to the left of E. L is an immediate neighbour of both D and N. G is not an immediate neighbour of F. How many people sit between M and N when counted from the right of M?
solution: Given, D, E. F. G, L, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F sits third to the left of L. L is an immediate neighbour of both D and N.
